responseMessageContents.text: Let me look at the add-mountain page to understand why the save button is greyed out.

The issue is a naming conflict on line 27 — `Mountain` is imported from both `lucide-react-native` (line 19) and `@/constants/mountains` (line 27), so the icon import gets overwritten by the type import, and the icon `<Mountain>` component becomes undefined.

edits.newString: import { Mountain as MountainType, MountainCategory } from '@/constants/mountains';

responseMessageContents.text: The save button should work now. The issue was a naming conflict — both the `Mountain` icon from lucide and the `Mountain` type from your constants were imported with the same name, causing the icon component (and likely the whole screen) to break. I've aliased them to `MountainIcon` and `MountainType` respectively.

responseMessageContents.title: Fix the save button when adding a new mountain.
responseMessageContents.description: Fixed a problem that caused the save button to be greyed out and stopped users from saving their custom mountain peaks.
